featured_reviews.name: Aniket
featured_reviews.review_text:
Desert Junction on Hanuman Road, Vile Parle East, is one of the most popular hangout spots in the area, especially among youngsters, thanks to its delicious fast food and amazing range of desserts. One of the biggest highlights here is their Strawberry and Cream, very similar to what you get in Mahabaleshwar, and it has gained quite a fan base locally. Their Mango Kulfi Sundae is another standout item — rich, refreshing, and perfectly satisfying for anyone with a sweet tooth.

When it comes to food, the menu offers plenty of variety. The burgers are flavorful, the pizzas are well-made with generous toppings, and their French fries are crisp and tasty. From quick bites to dessert cravings, this completely vegetarian outlet has something for everyone.

They also have a well-maintained small party hall downstairs that can comfortably accommodate around 15 to 20 people. We recently celebrated my daughter’s birthday here with about 15 kids, and they absolutely loved the place. The food—pizzas, French fries, nachos, mini vada pav, mojitos, and delicious cakes—was a hit, and the music added to the cheerful vibe.

Overall, Desert Junction is a clean, affordable, and fun place for family outings, kitty parties, and small get-togethers. My personal favourite remains the Mango Kulfi Sundae—highly recommended!
